white-vanilla-orchids.name: White Vanilla Orchids
white-vanilla-orchids.story: The sweet floral room. Chanel and white vanilla orchids in the air — a full strip club rendered in two nouns (Oliver Francis, 'Slomo'). Slow, bright, wide, builds to the end. The scent-anchored mood channel.

porcelain.name: Porcelain
porcelain.story: Piano-ride soul food. Unhurried story told over ~91 BPM keys; the cadence rides the piano attacks (z=+5.1, far above chance) and the lead line wanders 14.5 semitones. The rare animal: a voice that dances with the melody instrument.

razorblade.name: Razorblade
razorblade.story: The dark passenger. Keys pulse underneath while the voice steamrolls the beat grid (67.5% beat lock, piano-lock at chance). A sermon delivered at the engine — Vinnie Paz's lane.

dread-drift.name: Dread Drift
dread-drift.story: The creeper. Flat, steely dread, darkest timbre of the lane, and a voice that actively dodges the piano hits (z=-4.7) threading between them. The drip you can hear: no relief, no brightness, just held tension.
